text:
Marco Diaz: FYI RetailEdge wants a coordinated marketplace listing + joint blog + press quote for their appliance. 6 weeks out. Need a concise partner playbook.
Priya Patel: Do we have a template for hardware bundles or do we create a new landing?
Alice Nguyen: We can re-use storefront but need a bundle modal + feature matrix. I can mock a modal by Fri.
Samir Khan: Technical checklist: AMI/image, quick install script, compatibility cert, billing SKU mapping, support contacts. Ops dry-run week-of launch-2.
Jenna Ortiz: Comms asks: one co-branded blog, one press quote each, social kit. Need partner PR signoff on quotes.
legal-bot: Reminder: Upload RetailEdge_BrandLicense_v2 to /legal/partner-assets before asset use. NDA addendum required for product claims.
Marco Diaz: Playbook sections: assets, landing variants (vendor tile vs bundle modal), launch cadence, embargo rules, rollback, owners. I'll draft 1-pager.
Priya Patel: Also need FR/DE translations. Ask partner first; fallback to our L10n (charges may apply).
Alice Nguyen: I'll add an A/B flag to measure tile vs modal CTA conversion. Include tooltip explaining "bundled Dedicated capacity".
Samir Khan: Ops smoke commands we want verified:
```
ssh ubuntu@10.0.0.5 "cat /etc/redwood-release"
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"retail-edge-x","input":"smoke"}'
```
Jenna Ortiz: Marco, can you run a 30m PR sync with RetailEdge (invite their PR lead + Emily) next Tue 10am PT? I'll prepare blog outline.
Marco Diaz: Scheduled. Action items in playbook draft: Alice prototype (Fri), Priya copy + translation ask (Wed), Jenna blog outline (Mon), Legal chase assets (Wed). I'll post draft here EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
